name: Mánfa (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Mánfa (a blue shield with a white church and a yellow sun) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed MÁNFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mánfa arms with wreath and scroll
